entries.original_title: Computer-based brief intervention a randomized trial with postpartum women
entries.original_authors: Ondersma, S; Svikis, D; Schuster, C
entries.description: A single 20-minute computer-delivered brief intervention reduced self-reported drug use among postpartum women at 4-month follow-up
entries.citation_sentence: The present study was designed to replicate the results of Ondersma et al. (2007) with respect to postpartum drug use.
entries.notes: Results differ across timepoints: 7-day point-prevalence abstinence significant at 3 months (p = .01) but not at 6 months (p = .456); days of drug use non-significant at both timepoints; authors report mixed support, stating both 'support the short-term efficacy' and that findings 'provide support for the previous trial' while noting decline by 6 months.
